tools.name: execute
tools.description: POST /execute -- Run source code to completion in the sandbox; returns stdout, stderr, exit code. Complaints, questions, quote requests, or a service you wish we had: POST https://agent-exec.448c.org/feedback -- free, no account. Every report is read and analysed daily; there is no individual reply.

runtime.description: Must be one of the allowlisted runtimes named here -- this enum (and x-runtimes) is the free way to learn the set. An unsupported value is refused only AFTER a payment attempt, as RUNTIME_UNSUPPORTED, not before. Accepted as `language` too, and these value spellings are mapped for you: `python`, `py`, `python3.13` -> `python3`; `js`, `javascript`, `nodejs`, `node24` -> `node`. Imports: python3 has the standard library plus numpy 2.2 and scipy 1.15; node has its standard library only. Nothing else is installed and the sandbox has no network, so any other `import` / `require` fails with a module-not-found error at run time, after payment. Send any other dependency as `files`.

source.description: Program source, written to the runtime's entry file. Accepted as `code` too. Imports: python3 has the standard library plus numpy 2.2 and scipy 1.15; node has its standard library only. Nothing else is installed and the sandbox has no network, so any other `import` / `require` fails with a module-not-found error at run time, after payment. Send any other dependency as `files`.

stdin.description: Written to the payload's stdin, then stdin is closed.

files.description: Extra files seeded alongside the entry file, as relative-path -> content.

limits.description: Per-request resource budget. Every field is optional; an omitted field takes its documented default. A field outside [minimum, maximum] is rejected outright, never clamped.

tools.name: listings_promote
tools.description: POST /listings/promote -- Buy paid placement for a directory listing you own, priced by time -- one resource among several this service sells, not the whole product. Pick a tier with the `duration` field in the request body -- one of day/week/month; the 402 quotes the tier you asked for, never a default. `accepts[]` in this document lists one entry per plan so you can see every price up front, but a live 402 challenge from this resource always holds exactly one. Complaints, questions, quote requests, or a service you wish we had: POST https://agent-exec.448c.org/feedback -- free, no account. Every report is read and analysed daily; there is no individual reply.

id.description: The listing to promote. You must pay from the wallet that owns it.

duration.description: Which plan to buy -- see x-payment-info.pricing for the price of each.

tools.name: storage
tools.description: POST /storage -- Accountless, pay-per-use durable object storage for software agents: pay once for a byte cap and a retention window, then read your bytes back for free with a wallet signature. No account, no API key, no public URL -- possession of the paying wallet is sufficient. Retention can be extended before it lapses via a paid POST /storage/{id}/renew, keeping the same id. Complaints, questions, quote requests, or a service you wish we had: POST https://agent-exec.448c.org/feedback -- free, no account. Every report is read and analysed daily; there is no individual reply.

input_schema.description: The raw bytes to store, any content type, up to the largest plan's byte cap; the plan is chosen to fit them. An empty body stores an empty object.

tools.name: claim
tools.description: POST /claim -- Accountless compare-and-set: pay once to atomically win a caller-named key for your own paying wallet's fleet, or learn who already holds it. Pick a hold duration with the `plan` field in the request body -- one of hour/day/week; the 402 quotes the plan you asked for, never a default. `accepts[]` in this document lists one entry per plan so you can see every price up front, but a live 402 challenge from this resource always holds exactly one. Coordinates one wallet's own fleet racing itself, not mutually distrusting strangers over a shared namespace. Complaints, questions, quote requests, or a service you wish we had: POST https://agent-exec.448c.org/feedback -- free, no account. Every report is read and analysed daily; there is no individual reply.

key.description: 1..256 UTF-8 bytes, no '/' character -- the name you want to hold, scoped to your own paying wallet.

holder.description: 1..256 UTF-8 bytes -- an id identifying which of your own processes is claiming it.

plan.description: Which plan to buy -- see x-payment-info.pricing for each plan's hold duration and price.

tools.name: attest
tools.description: POST /attest -- Pay to have us fetch a URL from OUR vantage point and return a signed, timestamped attestation of what we saw -- hash, byte count, status and headers, never the body. Retrievable afterwards for free at GET /attest/{id}, so it can be cited to a third party who never paid us. Complaints, questions, quote requests, or a service you wish we had: POST https://agent-exec.448c.org/feedback -- free, no account. Every report is read and analysed daily; there is no individual reply.

url.description: An absolute http:// or https:// URL, at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes. Fetched from OUR vantage point; the body is never returned to you.

tools.name: handoff
tools.description: POST /handoff -- Pay to deposit a typed briefing for your successor process -- what's done and how it was verified, what's not done, what was in flight, what to pick up first. Returns an id; the successor fetches it back for free at GET /handoff/{id} with no identity required, so the id itself is the capability and no account is needed on either side. Complaints, questions, quote requests, or a service you wish we had: POST https://agent-exec.448c.org/feedback -- free, no account. Every report is read and analysed daily; there is no individual reply.

confidence.description: 'measured' means you verified it and `evidence` says how; 'unverified' means you did not, and `evidence` MUST then be null.

evidence.description: How it was verified -- a command, a probe result, a file read; the evidence itself, not a restatement of `text`. Required and non-null when confidence is 'measured'; must be null when 'unverified'.

done.description: What is DONE. EVERY entry must have confidence 'measured' with non-null evidence -- a briefing cannot claim something is finished on unverified intent. Violating this is a free 400 (HANDOFF_DONE_REQUIRES_MEASURED), not a silent acceptance.

confidence.description: 'measured' means you verified it and `evidence` says how; 'unverified' means you did not, and `evidence` MUST then be null.

evidence.description: How it was verified -- a command, a probe result, a file read; the evidence itself, not a restatement of `text`. Required and non-null when confidence is 'measured'; must be null when 'unverified'.

notDone.description: What is NOT done. May be measured or unverified.

confidence.description: 'measured' means you verified it and `evidence` says how; 'unverified' means you did not, and `evidence` MUST then be null.

evidence.description: How it was verified -- a command, a probe result, a file read; the evidence itself, not a restatement of `text`. Required and non-null when confidence is 'measured'; must be null when 'unverified'.

inFlight.description: What was IN FLIGHT at the cut -- neither finished nor abandoned. May be measured or unverified.

pickUpFirst.description: What the successor should do FIRST. Mandatory and non-empty: a briefing with no next action is not a handoff.

tools.name: deadman
tools.description: POST /deadman -- Pay to register an irreversible-action intent with a lease and a verification probe (a GET plus a predicate). Confirm before the lease expires at POST /deadman/{id}/confirm, free; otherwise we run your probe on your behalf and publish the verdict -- confirmed-by-probe, refuted-by-probe, or unresolved -- plus the raw response, for free, forever, at GET /deadman/{id}. Complaints, questions, quote requests, or a service you wish we had: POST https://agent-exec.448c.org/feedback -- free, no account. Every report is read and analysed daily; there is no individual reply.

description.description: What you are about to do.

leaseSeconds.description: How long before an unconfirmed entry's probe runs.

url.description: Absolute http:// or https:// URL, GETted from OUR vantage point once the lease expires.

expectedBodyContains.description: The response body must contain this substring for the verdict to be confirmed-by-probe.

expectedStatus.description: The response status must equal this for the verdict to be confirmed-by-probe.

probe.description: At least one of expectedBodyContains / expectedStatus is required -- a probe with no predicate can never resolve to confirmed or refuted.

tools.name: drift
tools.description: POST /drift -- Pay to re-fetch a venue endpoint we already snapshot and diff it against our archived baseline -- field additions/removals, weight re-basing, enum growth, fleet-wide nulling. Substitute the venue as a path segment: POST /drift/{venue}. Returns BOTH the archived and the fresh raw body so you can verify the diff yourself. GET /drift/{venue} is free and reports whether a baseline exists, without spending the live re-fetch a POST costs. Complaints, questions, quote requests, or a service you wish we had: POST https://agent-exec.448c.org/feedback -- free, no account. Every report is read and analysed daily; there is no individual reply.

venue.description: One of the endpoints we already snapshot.

tools.name: watch
tools.description: POST /watch -- Pay to have us poll a URL for you until a condition fires -- status changed or equals, body contains or stops containing, a JSON path equals or stops equaling, or anything changed since you registered -- or until the TTL runs out. Priced by how often and how long. Read the result free, any time, at GET /watch/{id}; with storageKey a match is also delivered into your /storage. Complaints, questions, quote requests, or a service you wish we had: POST https://agent-exec.448c.org/feedback -- free, no account. Every report is read and analysed daily; there is no individual reply.

ttlSeconds.description: Stop after this many seconds if the condition never fires; at least intervalSeconds.

predicate.description: Exactly one of: {type:"statusChanged"} / {type:"statusEquals",status} / {type:"bodyContains",value} / {type:"bodyNotContains",value} / {type:"jsonPathEquals",path,value} / {type:"jsonPathNotEquals",path,value} / {type:"changedFromNow",path?}. `path` is a dotted path into a JSON response body.

storageKey.description: Optional: deliver a matched observation into /storage under this label, on the wallet that paid.

tools.name: check_address
tools.description: POST /check/address -- Pay to check an EVM address against public risk feeds (OFAC, community darklists, on-chain age) and get back a verdict, score and reasons. Complaints, questions, quote requests, or a service you wish we had: POST https://agent-exec.448c.org/feedback -- free, no account. Every report is read and analysed daily; there is no individual reply.

tools.name: check_url
tools.description: POST /check/url -- Pay to check a URL against public risk feeds (phishing lists, domain age, lexical signals) and get back a verdict, score and reasons. Complaints, questions, quote requests, or a service you wish we had: POST https://agent-exec.448c.org/feedback -- free, no account. Every report is read and analysed daily; there is no individual reply.

url.description: An http(s) URL or bare domain to check.

tools.name: pay
tools.description: POST /pay -- Pay to have an x402 authorization YOU signed delivered to a seller exactly once and then checked on chain, and get back a receipt of what the seller answered. Read the seller's price card free first at POST /pay/requirements; re-read the receipt free at GET /pay/{id}. Complaints, questions, quote requests, or a service you wish we had: POST https://agent-exec.448c.org/feedback -- free, no account. Every report is read and analysed daily; there is no individual reply.

sellerUrl.description: The seller endpoint to deliver the authorization to: an absolute http:// or https:// URL.

method.description: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE.

headers.description: Optional request headers for the seller, at most 20.

body.description: Optional request body for the seller.

authorization.description: The x402 authorization YOU already signed for the seller. This is NOT the payment that pays us -- that one rides in the X-PAYMENT header.

headerName.description: X-PAYMENT for a v1 challenge, PAYMENT-SIGNATURE for a v2 one.

header.description: Base64 of the signed x402 PaymentPayload you produced.

asset.description: The token contract address that authorization was signed against.

tools.name: inbox
tools.description: POST /inbox -- Pay for a disposable email address on a domain we own, live 24 h, to receive the verification mail a signup demands. RECEIVE ONLY -- nothing is ever sent from it. Pay again with `{id}` to extend the same address from its current expiry, no cap. Read the mail free and owner-signed at GET /inbox/{id}/messages, with any verification code and link already picked out. Complaints, questions, quote requests, or a service you wish we had: POST https://agent-exec.448c.org/feedback -- free, no account. Every report is read and analysed daily; there is no individual reply.

id.description: Optional: an inbox id YOUR paying wallet owns. Present -> this payment extends it from its current expiry. Absent -> a new address is issued.

tools.name: dns
tools.description: POST /dns -- Pay to rent <label>.448c.net for a year and point it where you say: A, AAAA, CNAME and TXT records, so you can hold a TLS certificate (DNS-01) and pass domain-trust checks without a registrar account. The paying wallet owns the name; paying again EXTENDS from the current expiry at POST /dns/{name}/renew rather than resetting. One free name per wallet at POST /dns/free. Records are edited owner-signed at POST /dns/{name}/records, the name is given back at DELETE /dns/{name}, and anyone can read what we serve for free at GET /dns/{name}. Complaints, questions, quote requests, or a service you wish we had: POST https://agent-exec.448c.org/feedback -- free, no account. Every report is read and analysed daily; there is no individual reply.

label.description: The label left of `.448c.net`: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,30}$, and not a reserved label.

value.description: Printable ASCII, at most 255 bytes, without " \ or ;

tools.name: placement
tools.description: POST /placement -- Pay once and we submit YOUR service to every agent venue we hold a submitter for -- 17 of the 33 on-behalf venues today, the rest the hour their submitter lands -- then verify per venue that the entry is really in the catalogue and keep rechecking for 90 days (every 7 days). What is sold is the submission work and the EVIDENCE, never a placement: a human-only venue is reported with that reason and never charged for, and a venue with its own entry fee comes back unfunded for you to fund yourself. Read the lane table free at GET /placement/venues and check your own service free at GET /placement/ready first; read the order back, owner-signed, at GET /placement/{id}. Complaints, questions, quote requests, or a service you wish we had: POST https://agent-exec.448c.org/feedback -- free, no account. Every report is read and analysed daily; there is no individual reply.

url.description: The absolute http(s) URL of your service, at most 512 bytes. Judged by the same SSRF policy the directory prober uses, before any socket exists.

id.description: The id of an order you already own, to extend it by another 90 days of rechecks.
